name: judgmentkit
description: Activity-centered UI design and handoff guidance that helps Codex infer a working design premise, preserve intent into code, and enforce acceptance gates.

interface.shortDescription: Inference-first UI design, handoff, and acceptance
interface.longDescription: JudgmentKit helps product designers and design teams turn a rough brief, Figma or Adobe handoff, existing interface, or generated screen into a reviewed working premise and concrete design direction without beginning with an intake questionnaire. It infers a complete activity case, preserves consequential decisions through design and code handoffs, asks only when an unresolved choice would materially change the interaction, and enforces hard design-system acceptance gates before generated UI is accepted. It also routes JudgmentKit slide deck, presentation, PowerPoint, and PPTX requests from allowed source material. The hosted endpoint is for allowed or sanitized work; use a local or self-hosted JudgmentKit path for confidential briefs, unreleased designs, proprietary design-system details, source code, or customer data.
defaultPrompt: Make a first UI pass from this brief. Infer what you can, show the working premise and key decisions, and ask only if a missing decision would materially change the design.
Turn this sanitized Figma or generated screen into a reviewed activity case and implementation handoff.
Carry this reviewed design intent into a React prototype without losing its workflow or disclosure decisions.
Create hard design-system acceptance criteria for this interface.
Create a JudgmentKit slide deck from this product brief.
Turn this workflow review into a presentation handoff.
